faqs.a: Yes. Once the booking is confirmed, you receive your chauffeur's contact details and can coordinate pickup addresses, timing changes, and the end-of-night return directly, in addition to 24/7 dispatch support.

sections.heading: Planning a Safe, On-Time Prom Night
paragraphs: Prom night in Baltimore usually means several moving pieces: a getting-ready pickup, a stop for group photos, the dance itself, and often an after-party or late dinner before everyone heads home. We plan the whole sequence in advance rather than booking it as a single point-to-point ride, so the schedule holds even if a photo stop runs long or the group decides to add one more stop.

For parents, the appeal is straightforward — a licensed, insured, background-checked chauffeur replaces the alternative of teens driving themselves or splitting up across rideshare apps late at night. The vehicle and driver stay with the group for the whole booking, not just one leg of it.

sections.heading: Serving Baltimore's Schools and Venues
paragraphs: From City and County public schools to the area's private and parochial schools, prom season keeps our Sprinter vans and SUVs busy across Baltimore every spring. We pick up from multiple addresses when a group is splitting the ride, time arrivals around photo sessions at the venue or a nearby park, and handle the return trip just as carefully as the pickup — including a later-than-planned end time, which happens more often than not.
